zh: 阿拉伯联合酋长国大学（阿拉伯语：جامعة الإمارات العربية المتحدة）是一座位于阿拉伯联合酋长国艾因的公立大学，是阿联酋最早成立的大学之一. 在艾因内有六个校区.
根据2012/2013QS世界大学排名，该大学位于全球370位. 2010年，根据QS全球200个商学院报告，该大学的商学院名列非洲及中东前三甲. 根据2012/2013年泰晤士高等教育排名，该大学位于全亚洲第86位.
* 商学和经济学院 * 教育学院 * 工程学院 * 食物和农业学院 * 人文和社会科学学院 * 信息技术学院 * 法学院 * 医学和健康科学学院 * 科学学院
en: United Arab Emirates University (UAEU) is a public research university located in Al Ain, United Arab Emirates. Founded in 1976 by the country's first President, Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan, it is the oldest university in the United Arab Emirates and offers courses in various subjects up to post-graduation.
The United Arab Emirates University was established through the Federal Law No. (4) issued by Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan al-Nahyan, President of the United Arab Emirates in 1976.
The university is located in the city of Al Ain, an oasis city in the Abu Dhabi emirate 140 km east of the capital city of Abu Dhabi and a similar distance from the city of Dubai.
Students come from all seven Emirates and more than 81 other countries. 6,696 students live on campus. In 2024 enrolled international students constituted 19% of the total enrolled students.

The United Arab Emirates University is continuously ranked among the top university in the United Arab Emirates and 5th in the Arab region, the 229th in the world in the 2025 QS World University Rankings. In the 2021 QS Top 50 Under 50, i.e. the top 50 world universities that were founded within the past 50 years, UAEU was ranked number 27.
